1. Termination State Is Mandatory
Every artifact must declare exactly one termination state:

completed

aborted

deferred

panic

Artifacts without a termination state are invalid and may not propagate.

2. Retry Lineage Is Explicit
Any retry must reference a parent attempt ID.
Retries without lineage are invalid.
